task: T8 sym=2 brittleness diagnostic — find which dimensions of sym=2 differ from others to guide feature engineering
notes: sym=2 is the highest-volume, tightest-spread, lowest-per-tick-volatility stock (likely blue-chip/ETF). LOSO model trained on syms{0,1,3,4} reads sym=2's normal microstructure as 'accumulation→up' and predicts UP 62% of ticks vs true 18%. This is the core failure mode. Five sym-agnostic feature ideas proposed (F1=volume_z_within_window, F2=spread-normalized_moves, F3=relative_vol_quantile, F4=order_flow_ratios, F5=prior_calibration_head). F1+F2+F3 trio expected to add +3..+8 pnl on LOSO held=2.
